method: Parent and independent read-only reviewer inspected eight unmodified frames extracted from the actual ordinary-RAF Native02 recording. Neither this review nor the frame alignment measures GPU performance or human acceptance.
result: Bounded upright acquisition repair accepted; no recurrence of the prior low rod sweep across Briar was seen in the selected frames.

observations.adventure_0: HUD is active; precise initial rod pose is not clearly legible.
observations.adventure_1_to_3: Upright acquisition, raised diagonal cast and lower extension toward water are visible. Briar remains separate from the rod.
observations.follow_0_to_1: Small avatar, lantern and labels obscure the pole. These images do not independently establish the labelled early cast phases.
observations.follow_2_to_3: Outboard line extension and then float/ripple are visible away from Briar.

limits: Approximate trace-to-video alignment; not exact .05/.30/.55/.80 phase timing.
Selected stills cannot prove continuous clearance or smoothness between frames.
Lantern projection overlaps portions of the rod/line; physical collision is not established by these images.
Diorama onset legibility is weaker than third person.
